translations.title: ເລື່ອງລາວຜ່ານພາບຖ່າຍປ່າໄມ້

translations.caption_title: ໃຕ້ຮົ່ມໄມ້
translations.caption_description: ຊັ້ນສີຂຽວຫຼາຍຊັ້ນ ຂຶ້ນໄປຫາແສງສະຫວ່າງ.
translations.alt: ແນມຂຶ້ນຜ່ານຕົ້ນໄມ້ປ່າຝົນສູງ ເຖິງຜືນຟ້າທີ່ສະຫວ່າງ

translations.caption_description: Layers of green, reaching towards the light.
translations.alt: Looking up through tall rainforest trees to a bright patch of sky

translations.caption_title: ການຄ່ອຍໆກາງອອກ
translations.caption_description: ຮູບຮ່າງອັນງຽບສະຫງົບຂອງໃບເຟີນ.
translations.alt: ພາບໃກ້ຂອງໃບເຟີນທີ່ກຳລັງກາງອອກ

translations.caption_description: The quiet geometry of a fern.
translations.alt: Close-up of a fern frond unfurling

translations.caption_title: ນ້ຳເທິງກ້ອນຫີນ
translations.caption_description: ມອສ, ຄື້ນນ້ອຍໆ ແລະ ຮູບຮ່າງທີ່ກະແສນ້ຳເຫຼືອໄວ້.
translations.alt: ລຳຫ້ວຍໃສໄຫຼຜ່ານກ້ອນຫີນທີ່ມີມອສ

translations.caption_description: Moss, ripples and the shapes left by the current.
translations.alt: Clear stream running over mossy stones

translations.caption_title: ເສັ້ນທາງທີ່ອ່ອນໂຍນກວ່າ
translations.caption_description: ຄຳເຊີນໃຫ້ຍ່າງສຳຫຼວດໄກອອກໄປອີກໜ້ອຍ.
translations.alt: ທາງເດີນປ່າແຄບໆທີ່ມີໝອກ ລະຫວ່າງຕົ້ນໄມ້ສູງ

translations.caption_description: An invitation to wander a little further.
translations.alt: Narrow misty forest path between tall trees

translations.caption_title: ເມື່ອແສງສ່ອງຜ່ານມາ
translations.caption_description: ປ່າປ່ຽນໄປ ເທື່ອລະລຳແສງຕາເວັນ.
translations.alt: ແສງຕາເວັນສ່ອງຜ່ານປ່າທີ່ມີໝອກ

translations.caption_description: The forest changes, one sunbeam at a time.
translations.alt: Sunbeams filtering through the misty forest
